facts.value: half_aspect_ratio is inserted into bit 22 of gx->lpSize, whose updated word is emitted first. After a texture-state flush call, field_mode is ORed with 0x68000000 and emitted as the field-mode raster/BP command, followed by another texture-state flush call. GX initialization supplies rmode->field_rendering as field_mode and the test viHeight == 2 * xfbHeight as half_aspect_ratio.

facts.value: The source checks the GX primitive context and asserts pix_fmt is in 0–7. It updates the pixel/depth fields of peCtrl and emits peCtrl only if the complete word changed. On every such change, including a depth-format-only change, it sets genMode bit 9 according to pix_fmt == GX_PF_RGB565_Z16 and ORs dirtyState with mask 0x4 (bit index 2), even if the AA bit is unchanged. Formats mapping to primary code 4 independently refresh and emit cmode1's component selector. Every path sets bpSent to zero, including a path that emits no register.

State setters encode API arguments into raster/BP register commands; GXInitFogAdjTable instead computes the CPU-side correction table consumed by GXSetFogRangeAdj.

Defines the flush helper's BP-mask emission and bpSent assignment.

facts.rationale: Corrects the overly narrow AA-transition condition and makes the field-mode helper effect and CPU-only exception explicit without assigning an unsupported global meaning to bpSent.
facts.value: The entry points contain GX primitive-context checks. Most setters emit raster/BP commands immediately and assign bpSent = 0. GXSetPixelFmt emits peCtrl only when its encoded word changes; every such change recomputes genMode's AA bit and sets dirty mask 0x4, without requiring an AA-bit transition. Its component-selector write is independent, and bpSent is cleared even if no command is emitted. GXSetFieldMode writes lpSize, calls __GXFlushTextureState, emits the field-mode command and calls the helper again; that helper emits bpMask and clears bpSent. GXInitFogAdjTable only writes its caller-provided table. These command emissions do not establish GPU completion.
